metadata.verdict: SUPPORTED. ridge passes both gates under blocked, buffered CV: +5.2% MAE against bathymetry alone (so gravity and magnetics do add information beyond water depth) and +34.7% against spatial k-NN (so it beats mere proximity to existing seismic lines). MAE 474 m on labels spanning 267-7935 m.
caveats: Labels are a GRIDDED INTERPOLATION of seismic interpretation, not raw seismic picks. Errors in the published grid propagate into every metric here and are not quantified by this CV.
Metrics are valid only inside the Lindeque coverage (Pacific margin of West Antarctica). Applying the model elsewhere in Antarctica is extrapolation into a different tectonic setting.
A positive skill score shows statistical association, not a physical inversion. Do not present predicted thickness as a substitute for a seismic survey.
